confidence_notes: Overall medium. Food and drink anchors come from 2026 crowd-sourced cost-of-living aggregators (Expatistan, Combien-Coute, Almurakib, Lifeindexed), not menu checks, and were converted to USD. Restaurant meal and beer anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail rests on a downtown-club figure from only 7 data points that the source itself flags as unreliable, so it was discounted for a typical bar and set at roughly four times the beer anchor. Wine by the glass has no direct 2026 restaurant price in the results; wine_glass is set at roughly 2.5 times the beer anchor and checked against retail bottle prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Bogota context, not from live listings or searches; hostel and hotel tiers are the least certain. FX: the 2026-10-15 observation was taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced in search. The F11 table itself could not be opened, and a 16 October figure from a third-party site was not used because it could not be verified against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Bogota-specific aggregator data. Accommodation tiers and hostel pricing use general knowledge of Latin American capital-city budget and mid-range lodging.
